### 🌐 HTTP requests through Envoy Gateway (public-gw and internal-gw)
*route_not_found* = host or path with no HTTPRoute (typical for scanners hitting the raw IP). *no response* = connection closed before a request (e.g. TLS without a known SNI). IP geolocation by [DB-IP.com](https://db-ip.com) (CC BY 4.0)

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:envoy-gateway kubernetes.container_name:envoy response_code:* kubernetes.pod_name:~"^(${gateway})-" | copy ":authority" as host, "x-envoy-origin-path" as path, "user-agent" as ua | format if (host:"") "(none)" as host | format if (path:"") "(none)" as path | format if (ua:"") "(none)" as ua | extract "<client>:<_>" from downstream_remote_address | format "<kubernetes.pod_name>" as gateway | replace_regexp ("-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}$", "") at gateway | format "other" as status_class | format if (response_code:~"^2") "2xx" as status_class | format if (response_code:~"^3") "3xx" as status_class | format if (response_code:~"^4") "4xx" as status_class | format if (response_code:~"^5") "5xx" as status_class | format if (response_code:="0") "no response" as status_class | format "lan" as peer | format if (geo.src.country:*) "internet" as peer | filter peer:in($peer) status_class:in($status) host:~"${host}" | stats count() n

panels.description: Requests for paths typical of vulnerability scanners (.env, wp-login, .git, path traversal, …).

panels.title: Latency of routed requests (< 60 s)
panels.description: Excludes requests longer than 60 s: those are WebSockets and streams, not slow requests.
